_help: Everything Cedric says on the site. poke = said in order when poked, then loops. chat.replies = his FIRST answer in the chat (he is asleep; it comes with the message form). After that an in-browser LLM (brain.js) answers. chat.waking = status while the model loads (a percent is appended). chat.no_brain = said when the device cannot run the model (a form comes with it). chat.error = said when the model fails mid-answer. chat.after_sent = fallback when the visitor already sent Leon a message. Edit freely, keep the quotes and commas valid. blue_home = what Blue Cédric says when poked on the home page (4th line hints at the secret; the 5th poke shows the 'trip' button). ocean = the secret ocean: all French, whatever the site language. chat.awake = said when the model has finished loading (after the visitor presses Wake up). chat.nudge = said if the visitor writes before the Wake up button is ready.

replies: I was sleeping… but you can send a message to Leon and he'll get back to you. I'll probably wake up if you keep talking, though.
after_sent: Leon has your message. Keep talking, I'm waking up.
chat.sent: Done! Leon has your message and will get back to you.
chat.no_brain: zzz… I can't wake up on this device. The form above reaches Leon.
chat.error: zzz… I dozed off mid-sentence. Try again, or use the form to reach Leon.
chat.awake: *yawn* ok, I'm awake. Ask me anything about Leon.
chat.nudge: zzz… press the Wake up button below.
